extracted.intended_audience: mystery/crime writers, publishers, readers, and members of the Mystery Writers of America
extracted.subtask_description: Summarizes the Edgar Awards program and the eligibility/selection focus for its many prize categories (author awards and text/format awards) administered by the Mystery Writers of America. Useful for authors, publishers, and readers wanting the stated purpose or eligibility emphasis of each Edgar category.

rubrics_metrics.name: Robert L. Fish Memorial Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Robert L. Fish Memorial Award was established in 1984 to honor the best first mystery short story by an American author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Award targets a single short story (a writer's first mystery short story) and is limited to American authors; winners listed by year on the page (examples include stories published in Alfred Hitchcock's Mystery Magazine, Ellery Queen's Mystery Magazine, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Lilian Jackson Braun Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Established in 2022 in honor of Lilian Jackson Braun, it is presented for the "best full-length, contemporary cozy mystery."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies genre (cozy) and format (full-length, contemporary). Winners listed for 2023 and 2024 on the page.

rubrics_metrics.name: G. P. Putnam's Sons Sue Grafton Memorial Award
rubrics_metrics.description: Established in 2019 to honor Sue Grafton and is presented to "the best novel in a series featuring a female protagonist."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets novels that are part of a series and that feature a female protagonist; framed as memorial award honoring a specific author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Edgar Allan Poe Grand Master Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Grand Master Award (established in 1955) "acknowledges important contributions to the genre as well as for a body of work that is both significant and of consistent high quality."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes lifetime/contribution and consistent high-quality body of work rather than a single title; winners listed by year (many noted prominent mystery authors).

rubrics_metrics.name: Raven Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Raven Award was established in 1953 to honor "outstanding achievement in the mystery field outside of the realm of creative writing."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers non-creative-writing contributions to the mystery field (e.g., editors, organizations, publications, bookstores, advocacy) rather than fiction/television/film works; winners and main article referenced.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ellery Queen Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Ellery Queen Award was established in 1983 "to honor outstanding writing teams and outstanding people in the mystery-publishing industry."
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets collaborative writing teams and industry contributors (publishers, editors, promoters); winners listed on the page with associated organizations/roles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simon & Schuster Mary Higgins Clark Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Simon & Schuster Mary Higgins Clark Award was established in 2001.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Named award within the Edgar program; page lists it among active author awards (main article exists). Specific eligibility/selection language is not detailed on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Fact Crime (Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Fact Crime)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Fact Crime was established in 1948.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for non-fiction fact-crime works; page references a main article for full details but states establishment year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Critical/Biographical Work (Critical/Biographical Work)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Critical/Biographical Work was established in 1977.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for critical or biographical works about mystery/crime literature or authors; main article referenced for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Novel (Novel)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Novel was established in 1954.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Primary category recognizing a novel in the mystery/crime field; page links to main article for selection criteria and history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Paperback or eBook Original (Paperback or eBook Original)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Paperback Original was established in 1970.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes originals published in paperback or eBook form (distinct from hardcover releases); see main article for additional eligibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best First Novel (First Novel)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best First Novel was established in 1946.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes an author's first published novel in the mystery/crime field; main article referenced for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Young Adult Novel (Young Adult Novel)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Young Adult Novel was established in 1989.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Targets mystery/crime novels written for the young adult audience; see main article for precise age/eligibility guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Juvenile (Juvenile)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Juvenile was established in 1961.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Category for juvenile/children's mystery works; main article referenced for full criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Short Story (Short Story)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Short Story was established in 1951.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recognizes individual short stories in the mystery/crime genre; the page includes lists of winners in short-story-related author awards (e.g., Robert L. Fish).

rubrics_metrics.name: Best Episode in a Television Series (Episode in a Television Series)
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Episode in a TV Series was established in 1952.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Honors individual television episodes in the mystery/crime genre; main article referenced for selection details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Best Book Jacket
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Book Jacket was established in 1955 and discontinued in 1975.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical category; no active eligibility guidance beyond dates listed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Best Foreign Film
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Foreign Film was established in 1949 and discontinued in 1966.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical category recognizing foreign films; page only notes establishment and discontinuation years.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Best Motion Picture Screenplay
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Motion Picture Screenplay was established in 1946 and discontinued in 2009.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical category for screenplays; page notes creation and discontinuation years and links to main article for the category's history.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Outstanding Mystery Criticism
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Outstanding Mystery Criticism was established in 1946 and discontinued in 1967.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical recognition of critical writing about mystery; only dates are given on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Best Play
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Play was established in 1950 and is irregular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Irregularly awarded category for plays; page lists it as discontinued/irregular with a main article referenced for more detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Best Radio Drama
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Radio Drama was established in 1946 and discontinued in 1960.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical category for radio drama works; page lists establishment and end dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Special Award
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Special Award was established in 1949 and is irregular.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used irregularly for special recognitions; page notes its irregular nature and historical use.

rubrics_metrics.name: Discontinued category: Best Television Feature or Miniseries
rubrics_metrics.description: The Edgar Allan Poe Award for Best Television Feature or Miniseries was established in 1972 and discontinued in 2007.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Historical category for TV features/miniseries; page lists dates and notes discontinuation.
